question: door-hardware-sets
unit: ea (per door leaf, one complete hardware set fitted)

band.unit: ea (per door leaf, one complete hardware set fitted)
band.basis: Sum of the eight components above (no component counted twice: the QV mortice-lock row that includes furniture is used only as a cross-check, the QV hinge row is an alternative to the vendor hinge, and the restricted cylinder/keying line already contains a cylinder). Low end = mid-market hardware (Lockwood 3772 lock body, Schlage Form SSS furniture, Carbine EN 1154 size 3 closer, Yale BB hinges), wall-mounted stop, 1.75 hr at the QV Auckland carpenter rate. High end = QV-priced premium commercial hardware (QV lock furniture $365, QV SS hinge $39.20 each, closer with mounting plate), floor-mounted SS stop, 2.5 hr, higher setup allowance. Costs only - GST, preliminaries, margin, design/consent, the leaf, frame, hanging, machining, access control, fire-rated or smoke-seal hardware and access equipment are excluded per the brief. 25 leaves: $19,200 - $32,600 (mid ~$25,900). The band is wide because published NZ prices for the same grade span about 2x between mid-market vendor list prices and QV's premium-brand rows; it also straddles the brief's own $620-$880/leaf band, which is reached only with mid-market hardware. No premium is carried for a satin-stainless closer cover, so an SSS finish on the closer is an add.

band.unit: ea (per door leaf, one complete hardware set fitted to that leaf)
band.basis: Bottom-up per-leaf build: QV CostBuilder Auckland rows for the mortice lockset ($830), the 3 stainless butt hinges ($117.60, supply only), the door stop ($20.50-51) and the carpenter labour rate ($81.30/hr x 1.0-1.5 hr); fetched NZ vendor pages for the EN 2-4 adjustable overhead closer ($159.16-275 supply) and for restricted-keyway keying ($35-95 per door); one minor allowance for setup and handover ($10-25 per leaf). 25 leaves, one building, one floor, one visit; GST exclusive; Auckland 2026. Every line except the setup/handover allowance is genuinely per-leaf, so the rate holds for longer runs. Nominal 25-leaf total $29,200-$39,100 (mid ~$34,100). QV rows are unreviewed. Confidence is low because the largest line (the lockset) rests on a QV row whose fixing inclusion is unstated and whose brand/grade (Legge 991) is at or above the specified Grade 2, and because QV's own complete fire doorset rows imply a much smaller hardware content than QV's Hardware section rates do - QV is not internally consistent here. If QV's Hardware rates are supply only rather than supply-and-fix, add ~$60-100 per leaf and the band becomes ~$1,230-1,660. The separate QS band of $620-880 per leaf is only reachable with commodity imported Grade 2 hardware at supply prices, for which QV publishes no row.

band.unit: ea (per door leaf, complete hardware set fitted)
band.basis: Sum of the nine components above: QV-cited mortice lockset (830-1040) + QV-cited LCN overhead closer (800-980) + ball-bearing SSS hinges (43-118) + hinge fitting labour at QV's $81.30/h carpenter rate (33-49) + QV door stop (20.50-51) + restricted-keyway cylinder upgrade (45-95) + key cutting (30-60) + master-key schedule setup (10-20) + site setup/handover (6-14). Per leaf; 25 leaves = $45,400-$60,700 excl. GST. Two main cost drivers (lockset ~52% of mid, closer ~42% of mid together with it) rest on cited QV rows, so the band is established; allowances carry only ~3% of the total. Confidence is LOW because (a) QV hardware rows are UNREVIEWED and their inclusions are unstated - I have assumed the non-'Supply Only' tables are supply-and-fix, and if they are supply-only the band rises by ~$120-165 per leaf; (b) QV's lockset rows are Legge/Lockwood commercial combination-lock grade, above the Grade 2 equivalent specified, and a mid-grade lock could cut the lockset line to ~$450-700; (c) restricted keying is not published anywhere in NZ, only standard key cutting. This band sits 2.5-3x above the indicative $620-880/ea in the brief, and the difference is product grade (LCN closer, commercial mortice set, restricted cylinder) plus the full cost of 75 registered keys - not labour. Fire-rated leaves, hold-opens, access control, preliminaries and margin are excluded per the brief.
